//: The release the operator real-upgrade E2E (operator-real-upgrade.upgrade.spec.ts) upgrades FROM:
the latest published EDDI release, whose image and whose own Manager bundle activate the operator
before the image under test replaces it on the same MongoDB volume.
Bump it to the new release after every GA release, once its image is on Docker Hub
(docs/release-versioning.md, 'After a GA Release'). OPERATOR_UPGRADE_FROM_IMAGE overrides it
for a one-off run against another release.
